groupedDataTableBlock.title: Grouped Data Table
groupedDataTableBlock.description: Group records inside one table, with independent expansion, filtering, and per-group previews.
groupedDataTableBlock.compositionBody: Composes Container, DataTable, Badge, InputGroup, Select, and column-view controls. DataTable renders group headers and footers while preserving its existing record rows. No colors or style tokens are added.
groupedDataTableBlock.behaviorBody: Each group initially shows 3 records and supports independent expansion, collapse, and show more. Search and filters apply to the complete supplied dataset. Counts describe matching records regardless of collapsed or previewed rows. The groups array defines group order; sorting orders records within groups. Column visibility updates header and footer spans.
groupedDataTableBlock.integrationBody: Supply data, columns, groupBy, and a stable getRowId. The grouping column uses stable string values and should disable hiding. Optional groups define order, label, description, and an existing Badge category color; unknown values remain visible. This block supports one grouping level over a complete client dataset and disables global pagination. Remote queries must return complete matching groups; one fetched page cannot represent authoritative full-dataset counts. Compose public filters through renderFilters and connect domain actions in the host.
groupedDataTableBlock.dataApi: Complete records, domain column definitions, and stable record IDs. Demo data is exported separately and never injected by the core.
groupedDataTableBlock.groupsApi: Grouping column ID and optional ordered definitions containing value, label, description, and color.
groupedDataTableBlock.previewApi: Initial records presented per expanded group, clamped to at least 1. Does not truncate filtering or counting.
groupedDataTableBlock.expandedApi: Controlled or uncontrolled expansion, initially all expanded. Controlled changes emit an updater and wait for new props.
groupedDataTableBlock.slotsApi: Compose filters with the TanStack instance; append domain summaries from all matching records.
groupedDataTableBlock.activationApi: Active record highlight and activation callback. Group headers and nested controls do not activate records.
groupedDataTableBlock.stateApi: Ready, loading, and error states. Loading uses Skeleton; errors support custom copy and retry. Empty data shows an empty state.
groupedDataTableBlock.labelsApi: Override block copy; groupedDataTableZhLabels and groupedDataTableEnLabels are exported.
